manifestDescription.message: Save public articles, papers, audio and video locally through your AI agent and browser.

quickStart.message: From a link to a usable local file

stepChooseBody.message: Decide whether you want to read, watch or listen to the content.

stepAskBody.message: Give your local agent the public URL, desired format and authorized folder.

stepUseBody.message: Wait for the final job status, then use the saved document, media or PDF.

settingsIntro.message: Keep routine use on the overview page. Configure the local agent, runtime connection and diagnostics here.

disconnectBody.message: Removes the local pairing and closes only task tabs still owned by this extension.

heading.message: Collect useful content. Keep it locally.

intro.message: Save public articles, papers, videos and podcasts with your local AI agent. Choose what you want to read, watch or listen to.

setupIntro.message: Install the matching local runtime as well as this extension. Managed background startup currently supports macOS only. Choose an authorized output folder; never paste local tokens here.

controlsIntro.message: Pause stops polling and new browser tasks. Revoke clears pairing and closes only tabs still owned by this extension.

footer.message: Task-created tabs are muted before navigation. Existing user tabs are read-only: they are not navigated, played, muted or closed.

pairedDetail.message: Only explicit targets submitted by your local agent will be handled.

connectionErrorDetail.message: Check runtime-status, then reconnect before collecting content.

pausedDetail.message: The runtime is paired, but the extension is not polling for new tasks.

waitingDetail.message: Start the runtime and authorize the actual extension ID shown here.

pairingNeeded.message: Authorize this extension ID with allow-extension, restart the runtime, then select Connect local runtime.

copyFailed.message: Clipboard access was denied. Select and copy the instructions manually.

saveFailed.message: Your language changed for this page, but could not be saved. Try again.

errorGeneric.message: The operation failed. Check the runtime and connection; include the error code when reporting a problem.

unreachable.message: The local runtime is unreachable. Start it and check runtime-status.

unauthorized.message: The pairing is missing or expired. Authorize this extension ID and reconnect.

protocol.message: The runtime response could not be read. Check that the runtime and extension versions match.

missingState.message: The extension did not return its local status.

prerequisite.message: Prerequisite: obtain a trusted, matching runtime package or source build. The extension alone is insufficient; download links and checksums are supplied with the release.

installSteps.message: From the built source root or the installed package root containing dist/, run the following on macOS. Replace /absolute/path/to/authorized/materials with your own absolute output folder:

readyInstruction.message: Continue only when runtime-status shows state=running, health=ready and restart_required=false. Select Connect local runtime on this page, then install the MCP entry:

reloadInstruction.message: Reload {client}, call babel_content_check and confirm the target browser is connected and not paused. waiting_client_reload alone is not a successful connection.

conflictInstruction.message: An existing or changed MCP entry with the same name will not be overwritten. Other services are left unchanged.

secretInstruction.message: Authorize only the actual extension ID above. Never paste client tokens, cookies or signed URLs into this page or chat.

unsupported.message: Your system reports {platform}. Managed startup is currently implemented only for macOS user sessions.

unsupportedAdvice.message: Do not use runtime-install on this system or treat a foreground serve process as a finished installation. A supported managed startup path is required first.

howToIntro.message: After setup, send a URL and your authorized folder to your agent. Use these examples with real URLs and paths; the extension page manages connection, not download submissions.

usageArticle.message: Save this public article <URL> with its text and images to <authorized folder>. Use document and return the final status and file paths.

usageAudio.message: Save this video podcast <URL> as MP3 to <authorized folder>. Keep the task tab muted and do not play the output automatically.

usageVideo.message: Save seconds 60–120 of this video <URL> as MP4 to <authorized folder>. Report the actual duration and any missing content.

usagePaper.message: Save this arXiv abstract page <URL> as a bundle with the original PDF to <authorized folder>. Report whether the PDF was saved.

usageSubtitle.message: Save the existing English subtitles for <video URL> to <authorized folder>. Do not transcribe audio; report missing subtitles honestly.

usageResult.message: Wait for the job result. Open content.md or the actual media/PDF. queued is not completion; partial means some requested content is missing. Ask your agent to inspect or resume the same job ID.

usageLimits.message: Public, free content only. Some of the 15 registered sources remain experimental: X, Reddit, Xiaohongshu, WeChat articles and GitHub Markdown blob have known gaps. Subtitle files may be usable while their job remains partial.

privacyNote.message: The extension does not export cookies, browsing history or account credentials, and does not publish, comment, like or purchase.
